open_points.subject: Model M04 — PhotoPlacement.name
open_points.text: `name` is the source's relative path when it was placed and is not updated later.
open_points.question: Relative to which directory is `name`: the connection root or the configured photo subfolder?

witness.initial: A confirmed connection has root `/srv/object`, photo subfolder `photos`, and source file `/srv/object/photos/kitchen/a.jpg`; no placement exists.
events: The deliverer places the source photo and creates M04.
The calling flow receives the created PhotoPlacement.
witness.observer: The calling flow receiving the PhotoPlacement, and any later reader of that placement.
